description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Fenthoke Yerhesk)
- Vendor B (Netho Talcas)
- Vendor C (Vanol Sogarva)
- Vendor D (Yerume Ozhesk)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

Vendor A (Fenthoke Yerhesk):
  - Vendor A guarantees 99.9% uptime in its contract
  - Vendor A estimates deployment will take 5 months
  - Vendor A currently serves 53 hospital clients
Vendor B (Netho Talcas):
  - Vendor B has a clear product roadmap
  - Vendor B allows no customisation
  - Vendor B has a stable engineering team
  - Vendor B performs encrypted off-site backups
  - Vendor B includes free data migration
  - Vendor B estimates deployment will take 3 months
  - Vendor B quoted a total cost of 653 thousand per year
